   313	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], detail: 'opts.referenceNowMs invalid' };
   314	      }
   315	    }
   316	    var refMs = null;
   317	    var iso = null;
   318	    if (typeof snap.referenceNowMs === 'number') {
   319	      refMs = snap.referenceNowMs;
   320	      // Codex E4-R2-01 closure: canonicalization via captured intrinsics with round-trip
   321	      // verification. Post-load Date / Date.prototype.toISOString mutation cannot affect.
   322	      iso = _canonicalIso(refMs);
   323	    } else if (typeof snap.clock === 'function') {
   324	      var ciso = null;
   325	      try { ciso = snap.clock(); } catch (e) { ciso = null; }
   326	      if (typeof ciso === 'string' && ciso.length > 0) {
   327	        var ms = _isoToMs(ciso);
   328	        if (typeof ms === 'number') {
   329	          refMs = ms;
   330	          iso = _canonicalIso(ms);
   331	        }
   332	      }
   333	    }
   334	    if (typeof refMs !== 'number' || refMs !== refMs || iso === null) {
   335	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], detail: 'cannot resolve clock' };
   336	    }
   337	    return { valid: true, refMs: refMs, iso: iso };

   340	  // ---------- E4 timeline-event params validator (shared by append + project) ---------------
   341	  // Codex E4-R1-01 closure: projectTimeline MUST re-apply the SAME primitive allowlist
   342	  // used by appendTimelineEvent. The E1 contract is structurally permissive (params
   343	  // accepts any plain object); the E4 service layer adds the strict allowlist. A
   344	  // corrupted stored event with hostile params must NOT survive into an authoritative
   345	  // projection.
   346	  function _validateEventParams(params) {
   347	    if (params === null || params === undefined) return { valid: true, value: null };
   348	    if (!_isOriginalPlainObject(params)) return { valid: false, code: 'params not plain' };
   349	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(params)) return { valid: false, code: 'params has Symbol key' };
   350	    var names;
   351	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(params); }
   352	    catch (e) { return { valid: false, code: 'params desc fail' }; }
   353	    if (names.length > 16) return { valid: false, code: 'params keys exceed cap' };
   354	    var rebuilt = {};
   355	    for (var pi = 0; pi < names.length; pi++) {
   356	      var pk = names[pi];
   357	      // 'correction_of' is the canonical reserved key — its value is a strict id.
   358	      var keyOk = _reTest(SOBER_PARAM_KEY_RE, pk);
   359	      if (!keyOk) return { valid: false, code: 'params key not sober: ' + pk };
   360	      // Codex E4-R2-03 closure: even sober ids that match reserved hostile tokens (blame,
   361	      // cause, driver_error, ...) are forbidden in BOTH keys and string values. Narrative
   362	      // / causal / blame content must travel through i18n keys whose translations live
   363	      // outside the runtime — never as bare strings in the event params.
   364	      if (_containsReservedHostileToken(pk)) return { valid: false, code: 'params key matches reserved hostile token: ' + pk };
   365	      var pd;
   366	      try { pd = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(params, pk); }
   367	      catch (e) { return { valid: false, code: 'params desc fail at ' + pk }; }
   368	      if (!pd || pd.enumerable !== true) return { valid: false, code: 'params non-enum at ' + pk };
   369	      if (typeof pd.get === 'function' || typeof pd.set === 'function') {
   370	        return { valid: false, code: 'params accessor at ' + pk };
   371	      }
   372	      var pv = pd.value;
   373	      if (pv === null) {
   374	        // allowed
   375	      } else if (typeof pv === 'boolean') {
   376	        // allowed
   377	      } else if (typeof pv === 'number') {
   378	        if (!_isFiniteNumber(pv)) return { valid: false, code: 'params[' + pk + '] not finite' };
   379	      } else if (typeof pv === 'string') {
   380	        if (!_i18nKeyOk(pv) && !_idGrammarOk(pv)) {
   381	          return { valid: false, code: 'params[' + pk + '] string not strict i18n key / id' };
   382	        }
   383	        // Codex E4-R2-03 closure: reserved hostile tokens in string values are forbidden
   384	        // regardless of grammar match.
   385	        if (_containsReservedHostileToken(pv)) {
   386	          return { valid: false, code: 'params[' + pk + '] string matches reserved hostile token' };
   387	        }
   388	      } else {
   389	        return { valid: false, code: 'params[' + pk + '] not primitive (string/number/boolean/null)' };
   390	      }
   391	      try {
   392	        _CAPTURED_OBJECT_DEFINE_PROPERTY(rebuilt, pk, { value: pv, writable: true, enumerable: true, configurable: true });
   393	      } catch (e) {
   394	        return { valid: false, code: 'params rebuild failed at ' + pk };
   395	      }
   396	      // Codex E4-R1-03 / E3-R4-01 closure pattern: re-read descriptor and verify value
   397	      // identity with Object.is. Defeats pre-load defineProperty poisoning.
   398	      var dCheck;
   399	      try { dCheck = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(rebuilt, pk); }
   400	      catch (e) { return { valid: false, code: 'params re-read fail' }; }
   401	      if (!dCheck || dCheck.enumerable !== true || typeof dCheck.get === 'function' || typeof dCheck.set === 'function') {
   402	        return { valid: false, code: 'params post-define corrupt at ' + pk };
   403	      }
   404	      var same = false;
   405	      try { same = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_IS(dCheck.value, pv) === true; } catch (e) { same = false; }
   406	      if (!same) return { valid: false, code: 'params post-define value mismatch at ' + pk };
   407	    }
   408	    return { valid: true, value: rebuilt };
   409	  }

   540	    function appendTimelineEvent(inputIn, optsIn) {
   541	      // Step 1: descriptor snapshot
   542	      var inR = _snapshotPlain(inputIn, EVENT_INPUT_KEYS, CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID);
   543	      if (inR.valid !== true) return Promise.resolve(_block(inR.reasonCodes, inR.detail));

   548	      if (_arrIndexOf(EVENT_KIND_ALLOWED, i.kind) === -1) {
   549	        return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], 'kind not in closed enum: ' + i.kind));
   550	      }
   551	      if (!_i18nKeyOk(i.i18nKey)) return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], 'i18nKey not strict i18n key'));

   553	      // which applies the primitive allowlist AND the post-define value-equality re-read.
   554	      var pvR = _validateEventParams(i.params);
   555	      if (pvR.valid !== true) return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], 'params: ' + pvR.code));
   556	      var rebuiltParams = pvR.value;
   557	      // Correction event: correctionOf must be an existing event id (validated grammar)
   558	      // OR null/undefined. The store layer enforces append-only — the original event is
   559	      // never modified.
   560	      if (i.correctionOf !== undefined && i.correctionOf !== null) {
   561	        if (!_idGrammarOk(i.correctionOf)) return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], 'correctionOf invalid id'));
   562	      }

   565	      var ck = _resolveClock(optsIn);

   567	
   568	      // Step 4: fetch existing timeline to derive sequence (post-authority)
   569	      return timelineStore.getTimeline(i.caseId).then(function (existing) {
   570	        var existingEvents = (existing && _isArraySafe(existing.events)) ? existing.events : [];

   573	        // by createdAt; equal-timestamp appends are ambiguous (the deterministic eventId

   109	  function hasNonPlainNestedObject(o) {
   110	    // Codex E1-R1-01 closure: recursive descriptor audit. Walks every nested object/array
   111	    // descriptor, rejecting Symbol-keyed own keys, non-enumerable own keys, accessor
   112	    // (get/set) descriptors, non-plain prototypes (class instances / Proxy targets /
   113	    // arbitrary class), and sparse-array hole patterns.
   114	    //
   115	    // Codex E1-R2-01 closure: traversal overflow MUST fail closed (return true). Previous
   116	    // code returned false (clean) when the visit cap was hit, which let a hostile attacker
   117	    // hide a Symbol-keyed / accessor / non-plain object beyond node 4096. The walk now
   118	    // tracks both depth and node count; overflow on either dimension → reject. Depth is
   119	    // tracked per-node via parallel stack so depth>32 also triggers reject.
   120	    try {
   121	      var MAX_DEPTH = 32;
   122	      var MAX_NODES = 4096;
   123	      var stack = [{ v: o, depth: 0 }];
   124	      var visited = 0;
   125	      while (stack.length > 0) {
   126	        if (visited >= MAX_NODES) return true; // fail-closed on node overflow
   127	        var frame = stack.shift(); visited++;
   128	        if (frame.depth > MAX_DEPTH) return true; // fail-closed on depth overflow
   129	        var v = frame.v;
   130	        if (v === null) continue;
   131	        var t = typeof v;
   132	        if (t === 'function' || t === 'symbol' || t === 'bigint') return true;
   133	        if (t !== 'object') continue;
   134	        var isArr = Array.isArray(v);
   135	        if (!isArr) {
   136	          var p = Object.getPrototypeOf(v);
   137	          if (!(p === Object.prototype || p === null)) return true;
   138	        } else {
   139	          var p2 = Object.getPrototypeOf(v);
   140	          if (p2 !== Array.prototype) return true;
   141	        }
   142	        // Symbol-keyed own keys → reject at any nesting depth.
   143	        var syms;
   144	        try { syms = Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(v); } catch (e) { return true; }
   145	        if (syms && syms.length > 0) return true;
   146	        var names = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(v);
   147	        for (var j = 0; j < names.length; j++) {
   148	          var name = names[j];
   149	          // Array.length is non-enumerable own — skip it from the audit while still
   150	          // walking indexed entries below.
   151	          if (isArr && name === 'length') continue;
   152	          var d;
   153	          try { d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(v, name); } catch (eDesc) { return true; }
   154	          if (!d) return true;
   155	          if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') return true;
   156	          if (d.enumerable !== true) return true;
   157	          stack.push({ v: d.value, depth: frame.depth + 1 });
   158	        }
